{{Quote|We have the precise coordinates from our tracking device&hellip; like a gleaming beacon guiding us through the galactic wasteland.|Naga Sadow, on the eve of the Great Hyperspace War|<ref name="TFotSE3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref>}}
A '''tracking device''' was used by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Golden Age of the Sith|golden age]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] to trail the location of the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]''. The device sent precise coordinates of its location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] back to Naga Sadow, and the transmitter's signal was eventually locked onto by Sadow's [[Sith invasion fleet]] in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], where the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] waged [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|war]] against the Republic.

==Description==
{{Quote|BEEPBEEPBEEPBEEPBEEP|The sound of the device|<ref name="TGAotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>}}
The beacon was green and dark blue in [[Color/Legends|color]]. When active, the tracer made a continuous "beep" sound.

==History==
{{Quote|Lord Naga Sadow we have locked onto the signal from the ''Starbreaker 12''.''"<br />"''The beacon hidden on the ship has led us to the Republic at last!|A member of the Sith fleet and Naga Sadow speak through [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]|<ref name="TFotSE3" />}}
The tracking device was planted on the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] explorers [[Jori Daragon|Jori]] and [[Gav Daragon]], by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] in the latter's attempt to conquer the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''Starbreaker 12'', with its sole [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] being Jori Daragon, was sent by Sadow from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during its [[Golden Age of the Sith|golden age]] back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]], allowing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to gain direct access to the Republic. Crossing the fabric of hyperspace, Naga Sadow's [[Sith invasion fleet]] trailed the ''Starbreaker 12''{{'s}} tracer to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|heart]] of Republic space, leading to the outbreak of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The tracking device appears in [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]].
